install.packages("readxl")
library(readxl)
install.packages("rjags")
library(rjags)
install.packages("dlm")
library(dlm)
library(lubridate)
install.packages("forecast")
library(forecast)
install.packages("ggplot2")
library('ggplot2')
install.packages("tseries")
library('tseries')
install.packages("gridExtra")
library(gridExtra)
install.packages("tidyverse")
library(tidyverse)
install.packages("dplyr")




BD_Indice <- read_excel("datos/BD_Indice.xlsx")
View(BD_Indice)


tiempo<-as.Date(BD_Indice$year)
indice<-BD_Indice$`indice de cambio en el area`


plot(tiempo,indice, type="p", xlab= "Año", ylab="Índice de cambios en el área", main="Serie temporal", col="blue")

ggplot() + geom_line(data = BD_Indice, aes(x = tiempo, y = indice), color = 4, lwd = 1, linetype = 1) + ylab('Cambio en el Indice')+ geom_point(data = BD_Indice, aes(x = tiempo, y = indice))


count_ma = ts(na.omit(indice), frequency=12)
decomp = stl(count_ma, s.window="periodic")
deseasonal_indice <- seasadj(decomp)
plot(decomp)


adf.test(count_ma, alternative = "stationary")

Acf(count_ma, main='')

Pacf(count_ma, main='')

modeloarima<-auto.arima(count_ma, seasonal=FALSE)
modeloarima

prediccion <- forecast(modeloarima, h=30)
plot(prediccion)

###Serie de Tiempo todas las variables

BD_Indice$year <- NULL

z<-ts(as.matrix(BD_Indice), start = 2009, end = 2019, frequency = 12)
class(z)
plot (z)

predZ <- forecast(z, h=30)

summary (predZ)
plot(predZ)
head(z)


### Modelo HotlWinters
modelo<-HoltWinters(z)
is.dlm(modelo)

### Regresion Lineal Multiple
ModeloRegresion <- lm(BD_Indice$`indice de cambio en el area`~ BD_Indice$HUM_BOS + BD_Indice$TEM_BOS + BD_Indice$TEM_BOS + BD_Indice$TEM_PNN + BD_Indice$PRE_SECA, data = BD_Indice)
is.dlm(ModeloRegresion)


modeloR_2<-dlmModReg(z)
is.dlm(modeloR_2)

modelofiltrado<-dlmfilter(Base_de_datos, modeloR_2)


modARMA_1<- dlmModARMA(ar=list(as.matrix(BD_Indice), as.matrix(indice), ma=list(as.matrix(BD_Indice$HUM_BOS), as.matrix(BD_Indice$TEM_BOS), as.matrix(BD_Indice$TEM_CAL),as.matrix(BD_Indice$TEM_PNN), as.matrix(BD_Indice$PRE_SECA)), sigma2 = as.matrix(sd(as.matrix(BD_Indice$`indice de cambio en el area`)))))



residuales<-(residuals(mod2))

modFlit
